title: Scaffold optimization of indeno[2,1-g]pteridine sulfonates for enhanced DNA interactions, ROS generation, and Topo II inhibition.
authors: Cao, Meng-Nan; Wang, Jian-Guang; Ju, Kun; Liu, Yun-Hao; Yu, Ri-Lei; Xia, Ya-Mu; Gao, Wei-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计并优化吲哚并蝶啶磺酸酯衍生物，通过分子对接和MD模拟研究其与DNA及DNA-Topo II复合物的结合，属于小分子-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: In this study, a series of novel indeno[2,1-g]pteridine sulfonate derivatives are designed and synthesized. These compounds integrate the DNA-binding affinity of the pteridine ring with the covalent crosslinking ability of sulfonate moieties, aiming to induce multi-modal DNA damage. Scaffold optimization focuses on tuning the linker flexibility to spatially balance the intercalation depth of the pteridine moiety and the alkylating reactivity of the sulfonate group. Among them, 8q and 8r possess the strongest antiproliferative activities against A549 and HeLa cell lines. The interactions with DNA are investigated, and the results support their potential as DNA-damaging agents. Intracellular ROS levels in A549 cells are elevated by 8q and 8r, thus inducing oxidative damage to tumor cells. Molecular docking studies indicate that 8q and 8r have the strongest binding affinities to DNA and DNA-Topo II complex, consistent with their superior antiproliferative activities. Molecular dynamics simulations further support the theoretical basis for Topo II inhibition, and the experimental results demonstrate that the inhibitory effects of 8q and 8r on Topo II are comparable to that of mitonafide. Preliminary electrochemical studies are conducted to explore their possible metabolic pathways, suggesting that the redox processes involve reversible redox of the pteridine moiety and irreversible reduction of the indanone carbonyl group. Additionally, compared with busulfan, 8q and 8r possess markedly extended metabolic elimination times, which may allow reduced dosing frequency and improved bioavailability in practical applications.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，设计并合成了一系列新型茚并[2,1-g]蝶啶磺酸酯衍生物。这些化合物将蝶啶环的DNA结合亲和力与磺酸酯部分的共价交联能力相结合，旨在诱导多模式DNA损伤。骨架优化侧重于调节连接基的柔性，以在空间上平衡蝶啶部分的嵌入深度和磺酸酯基团的烷基化反应活性。其中，8q和8r对A549和HeLa细胞系表现出最强的抗增殖活性。研究了与DNA的相互作用，结果支持其作为DNA损伤剂的潜力。8q和8r使A549细胞内的ROS水平升高，从而诱导肿瘤细胞的氧化损伤。分子对接研究表明，8q和8r对DNA及DNA-Topo II复合物具有最强的结合亲和力，与其优越的抗增殖活性一致。分子动力学模拟进一步支持了Topo II抑制的理论基础，实验结果表明，8q和8r对Topo II的抑制效果与米托萘胺相当。进行了初步电化学研究以探索其可能的代谢途径，提示氧化还原过程涉及蝶啶部分的可逆氧化还原和茚酮羰基的不可逆还原。此外，与白消安相比，8q和8r的代谢消除时间显著延长，这可能在实际应用中允许降低给药频率并提高生物利用度。
